summary: Notes that many Windows installers don't return error information properly over WinRM (use become if it works locally), and some installers restart WinRM/HTTP services, making Ansible think the host is unreachable.
questions: Why does my Windows installer fail silently over WinRM but work locally?
Why does Ansible say the host is unreachable during a software install?

answer_card.title: Installer errors and unreachable hosts over WinRM
answer_card.answer_md:
- Many installers don't pass error info back over WinRM. If the install works locally, run the task with **`become`**.
- Some installers restart the WinRM or HTTP services (or make them briefly unavailable), so Ansible may report the host as **unreachable**.
